items.title: NetApp (NTAP) Acquires AI Storage Software Firm To Expand AI Infrastructure
items.summary: NetApp (NasdaqGS:NTAP) disclosed plans to acquire UK-based PEAK:AIO, a provider of high-performance storage software for AI workloads. The deal is expected to add advanced metadata capabilities and a parallel file system to NetApp's existing data infrastructure portfolio. Management highlighted that PEAK:AIO's technology is aimed at customers running large GPU clusters and enterprise-scale AI solutions. NetApp's move to acquire PEAK:AIO is worth weighing alongside the rest of our findings on...
